method.ceiling: best LEAVE-ONE-OUT least-squares over {tAir} and {tAir,rh,wind,cloud,solar}; an out-of-sample upper bound on any model using this forcing. In-sample fits overfit badly at n=12.
method.model: the physical model at its fitted (bound-pinned) parameters

night.why: air temperature explains night surface temperature well (r ~ 0.9), so a calibrated model is meaningful here

day.why: daytime surface temperature depends on site-level insolation, cloud timing and soil moisture that 50 km reanalysis forcing cannot resolve; no model on this data can do better
